message.reasoning_content:
The user asks for the sum of all prime numbers from 1 to 20, and wants the answer in one line.

Prime numbers from 1 to 20: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19

Sum: 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 11 + 13 + 17 + 19 = 77

Let me verify: 2+3=5, 5+5=10, 10+7=17, 17+11=28, 28+13=41, 41+17=58, 58+19=77. Yes, 77.
